requests: Recommend the best way to drywall the 9-inch concrete block ledge.
Say whether proper flat and level framing needs to be built out.
Say whether the existing front support is enough for the drywall without adding framing.
reason: The reply gives a step-by-step method: level and straighten the lower top plate, add a 1x2 strip at the front, fit foam, set a metal angle at the back along a level chalk line, then hang the drywall. Calling for a straight, level base and adding back support clearly implies that a flat build-out is needed and that front support alone is not enough. Those two questions are answered by implication rather than directly. The images are unavailable, but the text is enough to judge coverage.
